boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Undead are rising from the ground! You must hold on!
entries.target: 亡灵正从地下升起！你必须坚持住！

entries.source: Instantly travel to your jumpgate, as long as you are within %d tiles of it.
entries.target: 在 %d 格范围以内你可以立即传送至你的跃迁之门。

entries.source:
Concentrate on the battle, ignoring some of the damage you take.
		Improves physical damage reduction by %d%% and provides a %d%% chance to shrug off critical damage for 20 turns.
entries.target:
专注于战斗，忽略你所受的部分伤害。
		增加物理伤害减免 %d%% 同时有 %d%% 几率摆脱暴击伤害，持续 20 回合。
%s使用守护印记复原了干扰护盾(+%d)！

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#The Blood of Life rushes through your dead body. You come back to life!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#生命之血在你的尸体里流淌。你复活了！

entries.source: You can feel the psionic waves of power come from this yaech.
entries.target: 你可以在这只夺魂魔身上感受到庞大的灵能。

entries.source: Killed all four bosses of the Slime Tunnels.
#SLATE#* Use the control orb of Yiilkgur to begin the ceremony.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 使用伊克格的控制水晶球来开启仪式。#WHITE#

entries.source: This mindstar oozes a thick, caustic liquid. Magic seems to die around it.
entries.target: 这只灵晶在不断的向外渗出粘糊糊的液体。魔法似乎消逝在它周围。

entries.source: Hate when firing a critical mind attack:
entries.target: 精神暴击时回复仇恨值：

entries.source: The very fabric of space alters around #target#.
But... I did so much, I could do so much more for the Way by staying alive!
entries.target: 但是……我已经做了那么多，我活着还能为维网做更多！

entries.source: This crystalline structure seems to be filled with a malevolent aura. Through the crystal surface you can still see the remains of what once was a huge tree.
entries.target: 这个水晶一样的生物内部似乎充满了邪恶能量，透过水晶表面，你似乎还能看到里面曾是树的部分。

entries.source: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#The powerful darkness aura you felt wanes away.
entries.target: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#你感受到身边的黑暗光环消退了。

entries.source:
This mural shows nine Sher'Tul standing side by side, each holding aloft a dark weapon. Your eyes are drawn to a runed staff held by the red-robed figure in the centre. It seems familiar somehow...
There is some text beneath
entries.target:
这幅壁画显示了九个夏·图尔人肩并肩站着，每人手里都高举着一件一模一样的黑色武器。你的注意力集中在画面中间——被红袍者举起的符文法杖上。它看起来很眼熟……
下面有一行文字

entries.source: @Source@ tries to bite @Target@ with razor sharp teeth!
Got to level 150 of the infinite dungeon.
I am ready! Send me to Urkis!
entries.target: 我准备好了！送我去厄奇斯那里！

entries.source: Got to level 60 of the infinite dungeon.

Summon a Minotaur for %d turns to attack your foes. Minotaurs cannot stay summoned for long, but they deal high damage.
		It will get %d Strength, %d Constitution and %d Dexterity.
		Your summons inherit some of your stats: increased damage%%, resistance penetration %%, stun/pin/confusion/blindness resistance, armour penetration.
		The minotaur's Strength and Dexterity will increase with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
召唤一只米诺陶来攻击敌人，持续 %d 回合。米诺陶不会呆很长时间，但是它们会造成极大伤害。
		它拥有 %d 点力量，%d 点体质和 %d 点敏捷。
		你的召唤物继承你部分属性：增加百分比伤害、抗性穿透、震慑/定身/混乱/致盲抵抗和护甲穿透。
		米诺陶的力量和敏捷受精神强度加成。

entries.source: ...We are lost. The orcish forces are too great. No matter how many our squad slays, yet more surge from the depths. Where are the cursed creatures coming from?! We have spied their leader, but have had no hope in killing him; he is a beast, a destroyer, burning with fire infernal and ice cruel and chilling. The power these orcs wield now fills me with dread... perhaps they have found new, mighty allies? This news must reach our ruler. My comrades... I am sorry. I will flee once the opportunity arises, but know that your sacrifices will not be in vain. Long may our empire endure.
entries.target:
……我们完了。兽人大军势不可当。无论我们小队杀死多少，都会有更多兽人从深处涌来。这些该死的生物究竟从哪里来的？！
我们已经窥见他们的首领，却根本没有希望杀死他；他是一头野兽，一个毁灭者，身燃炼狱烈火与残酷刺骨的寒冰。这些兽人如今掌握的力量令我恐惧……或许他们找到了新的强大盟友？这消息必须送到统治者手中。战友们……对不起。我会在机会出现时逃走，但要知道，你们的牺牲绝不会白费。愿帝国长存。

entries.source: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.
entries.target: 血红色的物体不断滴落液体，散落在地面上。滴落下来的血液似乎有着自己的意志。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You carefully get away without making a sound.
This white cap is plain and dull, but as the light reflects off of its surface, you see images of faraway corners of the world in the sheen."
entries.target: 这顶白色的帽子朴素暗淡，但是，当光线在它的表面反射时，你从光泽中看到了世界遥远角落的景象。

entries.source: Take a step toward your foes then use the momentum to cleave all creatures adjacent to you for %d%% weapon damage.
entries.target: 向前跳一步，用这股力量对周围的目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。

entries.source: You arrived through the farportal in a cave, probably in the Far East.
entries.target: 你穿过了山洞的远行传送门，可能会到达远东大陆。

entries.source: It's a large yellow ant with sparks arcing across its body.
entries.target: 一只巨大的黄色蚂蚁，身体闪耀着电火花。

entries.source: A poem written for a rogue?
entries.target: 一首写给某个盗贼的诗歌？

entries.source:
It can be used to %s

Activation puts %s on cooldown for %d turns.
entries.target:
它可以用于%s

激活会将%s置入冷却状态%d回合。

entries.source: Make amends, magic-user, for the harm ye have wrought is beyond compare.
entries.target: 赎罪吧，施法者，你所铸成的灾祸无可估量。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信萨拉苏尔并杀死了乌克勒姆斯维奇。#WHITE#

entries.source: This phial seems filled with darkness, yet it cleanses your thoughts.
entries.target: 这个小瓶子似乎充满了黑暗，但却净化了你的思想。

entries.source:
You gain 25%% absolute damage resistance and 25%% all damage penetration.  Each time you are struck by a weapon these bonuses are reduced by 5%% but fully recovered after 8 turns.
			Additionally, you gain 70%% of the highest of your Magic or Dexterity stat as defense (%d)
entries.target:
你获得 25%% 绝对伤害抗性，25%% 全体伤害抗性穿透。
			每当你被武器攻击的时候，这项增益会减少 5%%，8 回合后完全恢复。
			此外，你将获得相当于你魔力和敏捷中最高的一项  70%% 的闪避值 (%d)

entries.source: #RED#%s has completed an %s without your aid.#WHITE#
entries.target: #RED#%s已经制造了%s，并没有获得你的帮助。#WHITE#

entries.source: The Sandworm Lair is to the far west of Derth, near the sea.
entries.target: 在德斯镇远一点的西面，靠近海岸的地方是沙虫巢穴。

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 尖牙利齿，火焰致命。似乎龙族并没有灭绝……
